empty.title: No vulnerabilities found
empty.desc: You're safe as of now. Re-scan if your code changes.

toast.copyFailed: Copy failed. Check your browser clipboard permissions.

detail.loadError: Unable to load the report. Please try again.

fixPrompt.intro: Explain how to fix the following security vulnerability, with an example tailored to my code.
fixPrompt.outro: Write out the specific fix code and configuration (headers/options, etc.) step by step.

source.title: Source location
source.snapshot: Code at scan time · up to five lines before and after the finding
source.current: Code fetched from the repository; it may differ from the scanned version.
source.unavailable: No saved excerpt or the original file is unavailable. Rescan to capture the code at scan time.
source.notProvided: This finding does not include source code and line numbers.

cpg.title: CPG graph
cpg.open: Select a node to inspect code
cpg.unavailable: No code graph is saved for this result. It may be an older scan, or graph extraction for this location was unavailable.
cpg.data-flow: A data-flow path extracted from CPG: input → propagation → use. Select a node to inspect code captured during the scan. This is the relevant path, not the entire CPG.
cpg.call-site: A call site detected in CPG. This result does not establish an input-to-sink data-flow path.
cpg.partial-flow: A partial path returned by the analyzer. The full connection to the final use is not included.
cpg.cpg: Code surrounding this finding, extracted from Joern. Choose an edge type and select a node to inspect its code.
cpg.limited: Some nodes or edges were omitted to keep this graph within the display limit.
cpg.context: Actual Joern code structure and flow around the AI-reported location. This context does not confirm the vulnerability.
cpg.error: The graph could not be displayed. Use the node selector below to inspect code.
cpg.graphDescription: CPG nodes connected by directional arrows. Nodes can also be selected from the list below.
cpg.noEdges: No edges of this type in the selected scope. Include surrounding code or choose another edge type.
cpg.interaction: Drag to move · Buttons to zoom · Select a node to inspect code
cpg.anchor: No call node at reported line {{requested}}; showing context around nearby line {{anchor}}.
